title: Gayathridevi Ente Amma
desc: Appu's father lies to him that his mother is dead. Devoid of a mother's love, Appu resorts to smoking and drinking until he learns that she is still alive.

title: Chamayam
desc: Esthappan and Anto are two fishermen who do not get along well. However, when Esthappan learns that Anto sings and dances well, he requests him to perform in his stage plays.

title: Pulliman
desc: Orphan Kunjunni and statue vendor Radha face familial opposition to their romance. Their love is tested as Radha's father disapproves of their relationship.

title: Appu
desc: Appukuttan is an honest young man who falls in love with Sarojini. But she does not like him. One day, Sarojini is found raped and murdered! Who killed her?

title: 7th Day
desc: A suspended crime branch officer gets involved with a group of friends who are caught in a problematic situation and are being followed by a local goon.

title: Vellathooval
desc: Jiya, a fun-loving girl, is tired of her conservative family and therefore decides to abscond with her friend Manu. They become good friends but the society misunderstands them.

title: Unnikrishnante Adyathe Christmas
desc: Sophia has an argument with her parents over her marriage and leaves the house. Her parents seek the help of her close friend, Unnikrishnan, in getting her back in the house.

title: Indrajith
desc: Join Indrajith on an adventurous trip to the lush forests of northeastern India as he embarks on a quest to discover a coveted precious stone. Excitement awaits!

title: Vinayapoorvam Vidyadharan
desc: Vidyadharan is a simple bank employee, but his meagre earnings are insufficient for his wife's extravagant lifestyle. Eventually, she costs him his job, forcing him to struggle.

title: Parvathy Parinayam
desc: What happens to Siva and his one-sided love for Parvathy who does not reciprocate his love?

title: Uppukandam Brothers
desc: Chacko is killed for being an informer of Ananthan Pilla's business. His son approaches Uppukandam Brothers, as the police refuse to file a complaint

title: Pilots
desc: Bobby falls for Cindrella, a nun, who, he had already met as Megha Mathew. When he is accused of murdering his friend, his life depends on the the girl's testimony.

title: Agnidevan
desc: The story revolves around the conflict between two brothers who share the legacy of Ezhuthupura, a newspaper company owned by the family.

title: Mookkillarajyathu Murimookkan rajavu
desc: Three bachelors find themselves tangled in a man's family drama as they embark on a house-hunting adventure, leading to unexpected friendships and hilarious misadventures along the way.

title: Govindankutty Thirakkilanu
desc: The film touches upon the humorous side of two very important aspects of law - the police and the advocates.

title: Tharavadu
desc: Unni's maternal uncle outcasts him as his father was a Muslim. However, Unni continues to meet his grandmother, who dotes on him and hopes that he will marry Rajani, his cousin.

title: Kadamba
desc: Janu is brought up by her father after the sudden death of her mother. Problems start brewing in her life when her father searches for a perfect groom, unaware that she is in love with someone else.

title: Swathi Thirunnal
desc: Swathi Thirunal ascends the Travancore throne at sixteen, succeeding his aunt Gowri Parvati Bayi, and grows to become a legendary composer of Carnatic and Hindustani music.

title: Janmantharam
desc: Four buddies in a village take on injustice but land in hot water when they clash with the landlord Panicker. Drama unfolds in this fight for justice and survival.
